notes.title: Package Rush is available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42576824/13320428a0c8cf6e62f714726db194ae23ab1799.png[/img]
[h1]Package Rush is available NOW![/h1]

Package Rush is a strategy game about planning a delivery route system in a fast-growing city. Build and modify routes to get all packages on time. How long can you keep delivering?

The city is growing. More and more orders are coming in, and there is less and less time to fulfill them. The demand for your company's services is increasing. You'll be constantly managing your route system to meet the changing conditions and be as efficient as possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972400/Package_Rush/

notes.title: Package Rush Demo is live NOW on Steam 🚚📦
notes.content:
[h1]Demo is live![/h1]

Dear Delivery guys!🚚

Package Rush Demo is live NOW on Steam. Try yourself as a delivery company manager. Build and modify routes to get all packages on time and be as efficient as possible! Customers are already waiting for their packages to arrive 📦

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42576824/1d9537e5677407f54e2fee05d259f31a161935e9.gif[/img]
